reasons: Direction is correct: HDI is the site developer/host (vendor) under Section 1.1 and the Company is our client, so the inserted warranty runs from HDI to the Company.

Status 'missing' is supported by the cited text: Section 9(a) contains only mutual corporate authority reps and 9(b) is a Globix carve-out, with no conformance/quality warranty or remedy anywhere in the excerpts; no 'AS IS' disclaimer exists, so no disclaimer carve-out was needed.

Redline is additive and minimal — a new Section 9(c) appended after 9(b) with no alteration of existing language — and delivers the preferred package (workmanlike Services, 12-month Site conformance, legal compliance, no malicious code) plus a re-performance/repair/replace/refund remedy consistent with the model language.
Comment is accurate, correctly prefixed, concise, first person plural, states what changed and why, and offers the 90/30-day fallback.

Minor caveat to confirm before sending: the cross-reference to 'Section 5.2' for the Company-approved specifications is not verifiable from the supplied paragraphs; if 5.2 does not govern specification approval, the reference should be corrected or generalized to 'the specifications and documentation approved by the Company.'
